DIRECTORATE OF ACADEMIC COMPLIANCE & STUDENT AFFAIRS
METROPOLITAN TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY (MTU)
CAMPUS ADMINISTRATION BLOCK, SECTOR 14

Ref No: MTU/COMP/2026/8941
Date of Issuance: October 12, 2026

NOTICE TO FINAL-YEAR CANDIDATES: DEFICIENCY OF MANDATORY VERIFICATION DOCUMENTS

To:
All Final-Year Degree Candidates (Batch of 2026)
Faculties of Engineering, Technology & Computer Applications

Subject: Deficient Enrollment Dossiers and Submission of Pending Certificates

1. BACKGROUND & FINDINGS:
During the annual pre-convocation audit conducted by the Registrar's Office on
October 10, 2026, it was identified that approximately 42 student dossiers remain
incomplete due to missing mandatory statutory documents.

2. SPECIFIC DEFICIENT DOCUMENTS:
Affected candidates are required to furnish certified physical copies of:
(a) Original Migration Certificate from the previous Board/University.
(b) Character Certificate issued by the Head of the last attended institution.
(c) Signed Anti-Ragging Undertaking (Affidavit Form Annexure-IV).

3. REQUIRED ACTION & DEADLINE:
Candidates must submit all deficient documents in person at Student Helpdesk
Counter #4 (Ground Floor, Admin Block) on or before:
DEADLINE: November 14, 2026 (5:00 PM IST).

4. ADVISORY & CONSEQUENCES:
Failure to clear documentation deficiencies before November 14, 2026 will result
in provisional withholding of mid-semester grade sheets and hall tickets for
December 2026 examinations. Late submissions after November 14 are tentative and
subject to approval by the Dean of Academic Affairs.

5. OFFICIAL CONTACT:
Academic Registrar Desk
Email: compliance@mtu-fictional.edu.in
Phone: +91-11-2099-4411 (Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM IST)

Sd/-
Dr. K. S. Ramanathan
